blocks.zh: 導論、術語定義與技術移轉類型
blocks.en: Introduction, Definitions and Types of Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 本節內容 Contents
blocks.en: Contents

blocks.zh: 解說 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼技術移轉越來越重要？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is Technology Transfer Becoming More Important?

blocks.zh: TR65 開篇點明四大驅動力：
blocks.en: TR65 opens by identifying four drivers:

blocks.zh: CDMO 使用擴展：藥廠越來越多外包製造，產品必須跨廠移轉
blocks.en: Expanded use of CDMOs: pharmaceutical companies outsource more and more manufacturing, so products must move between sites

blocks.zh: 製造彈性提升：多址生產、備援廠需要複製工藝
blocks.en: Greater manufacturing flexibility: multi-site production and back-up sites require the process to be replicated

blocks.zh: 企業併購整合：收購後需整合兩廠生產流程
blocks.en: Mergers and acquisitions: after an acquisition, the production processes of two sites must be integrated

blocks.zh: 法規複雜性增加：各市場有不同 CMC 要求，移轉需同步考量
blocks.en: Increasing regulatory complexity: each market has different CMC requirements, and these must be considered together during the transfer

blocks.zh: 比喻：TT 就像「廚師的食譜傳承」
blocks.en: Analogy: TT is like "passing down a chef's recipes"

blocks.zh: 想像一位米其林廚師要將他的招牌菜移交給另一家分店的廚師。光是給食譜（文件）不夠——新廚師還需要知道火候技巧、食材採購來源、甚至師傅的「眉角」。TT 就是這套傳授過程的系統化版本，確保「同樣的藥」在新廠也能做出來。
blocks.en: Imagine a Michelin-starred chef handing over a signature dish to the chef of another branch. Handing over the recipe (documents) is not enough: the new chef also needs to know the heat control techniques, where the ingredients are sourced, and even the master's "little tricks". TT is the systematic version of this hand-over, making sure the "same drug" can be made at the new site as well.

blocks.zh: 法規重點：ICH Q10 框架
blocks.en: Regulatory Focus: The ICH Q10 Framework

blocks.zh: TT 的法規基礎來自 ICH Q10（藥品品質系統），所有 CMC 要求都必須記錄在法規申報文件中。監管機關期望看到「有文件支撐的系統化流程」，而非僅憑口頭傳承。
blocks.en: The regulatory basis for TT comes from ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System), and all CMC requirements must be documented in the regulatory submission. Regulators expect to see a "systematic process supported by documentation", not knowledge passed on by word of mouth alone.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務場景
blocks.en: CDMO Practice Scenario

blocks.zh: 在 TWi 這樣的無菌充填 CDMO，TT 是核心業務之一：客戶（MAH）將其藥品工藝轉移給我們（RU）執行商業生產。每一個新客戶的導入，本質上就是一個 TT 專案。TR65 就是這類工作的專業依據。
blocks.en: At a sterile fill-finish CDMO such as TWi, TT is a core part of the business: the client (MAH) transfers its drug product process to us (the RU) to carry out commercial production. Onboarding every new client is, in essence, a TT project. TR65 is the professional reference for this kind of work.

blocks.zh: 思考問題
blocks.en: Questions to Consider

blocks.zh: 您目前公司正在進行的 TT 專案，屬於哪種驅動力？是 CDMO 導入新客戶、企業併購整合，還是市場擴張需求？
blocks.en: Which driver applies to the TT project your company is currently running: a CDMO onboarding a new client, an M&A integration, or a market expansion need?

blocks.zh: 核心工具：矩陣式參考指南
blocks.en: Core Tool: The Matrix-Style Reference Guide

blocks.zh: TR65 的核心交付物是一個「活動與交付清單矩陣（Reference Guide）」，以表格形式呈現：
blocks.en: The core deliverable of TR65 is an "activities and deliverables matrix (Reference Guide)", presented in table form:

blocks.zh: 縱軸：TT 的六個階段
blocks.en: Vertical axis: the six stages of TT

blocks.zh: 橫軸：各跨功能部門（Process、Analytical、QA 等）
blocks.en: Horizontal axis: the cross-functional departments (Process, Analytical, QA, etc.)

blocks.zh: 格中內容：每個部門在每個階段應完成的活動與交付文件
blocks.en: Cell contents: the activities and deliverable documents each department should complete in each stage

blocks.zh: 這讓複雜的 TT 工作變得可追蹤、可問責。
blocks.en: This makes complex TT work traceable and accountable.

blocks.zh: 重要提示：TT 沒有「一體適用」
blocks.en: Important Note: There Is No "One Size Fits All" in TT

blocks.zh: TR65 明確指出，每個 TT 的細節差異很大，此報告提供的是「可跨類型應用的框架」，而非逐字照搬的 SOP。使用時需依據產品類型、複雜度與生命週期階段調整。
blocks.en: TR65 states explicitly that the details of each TT differ greatly. The report provides a "framework that can be applied across types", not an SOP to be copied word for word. It must be adapted to the product type, complexity and lifecycle stage.

blocks.zh: 比喻：蓋房子用的施工圖
blocks.en: Analogy: The Construction Drawings for Building a House

blocks.zh: TR65 像是「建築藍圖標準」，不是某棟特定房子的設計圖。每個 TT 專案是一棟房子，TR65 告訴你每個工種（水電、結構、裝修）在哪個施工階段要做什麼，但具體尺寸和材料要你自己填。
blocks.en: TR65 is like a "building blueprint standard", not the design drawing of one specific house. Each TT project is a house. TR65 tells you what each trade (plumbing and electrical, structure, finishing) must do at which construction stage, but you fill in the actual dimensions and materials yourself.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍明確：最聚焦在 Phase III 到商業化
blocks.en: Clearly Defined Scope: Focused on Phase III to Commercialization

blocks.zh: TR65 的「甜蜜點」是臨床第三期到商業生產的移轉，以及商業廠之間的移轉。這兩種情境 CMC 要求最完整、法規要求最嚴格。早期臨床（Phase I/II）的 TT 要求相對寬鬆，TR65 不詳述差異。
blocks.en: The "sweet spot" of TR65 is transfer from Phase III clinical trials to commercial production, and transfer between commercial sites. In these two scenarios the CMC requirements are the most complete and the regulatory expectations the strictest. TT for early clinical phases (Phase I/II) has relatively looser requirements, and TR65 does not describe the differences in detail.

blocks.zh: 範圍外的重要提示
blocks.en: Important Notes on What Is Out of Scope

blocks.zh: 不涵蓋：醫療器材、組合產品、ATMP 的特殊要求
blocks.en: Not covered: the special requirements of medical devices, combination products and ATMPs

blocks.zh: 不涵蓋：商業生產後的例行作業（CPV、年度產品報告）
blocks.en: Not covered: routine operations after commercial production starts (CPV, annual product review)

blocks.zh: TT 的終點：監管批准後的移交（Handover），之後由 Operations 接手
blocks.en: End point of TT: Handover after regulatory approval, after which Operations takes over

blocks.zh: 釐清終點很重要——TT 專案有開始、有結束，不是永久性職責。
blocks.en: Clarifying the end point is important: a TT project has a beginning and an end, and is not a permanent responsibility.

blocks.zh: 對於無菌充填 CDMO，範圍界定尤其關鍵。客戶常將 TT 後的持續支援需求混入 TT 合約。TR65 提供依據：TT 在監管批准後的 Handover 即告終止，後續 CPV 和年度驗證是另一個服務合約的範疇。
blocks.en: Defining the scope is especially critical for a sterile fill-finish CDMO. Clients often fold their need for ongoing support after TT into the TT contract. TR65 provides the basis for drawing the line: TT ends at Handover after regulatory approval, and the subsequent CPV and annual validation fall under a separate service contract.

blocks.zh: 您的公司是否曾因 TT 範圍不清，導致 TT 團隊在移交後仍持續被客戶要求協助日常生產問題？這種情況如何用 TR65 的框架來界定邊界？
blocks.en: Has your company ever had the TT team continue to be asked by the client to help with day-to-day production issues after handover because the TT scope was unclear? How could the TR65 framework be used to define the boundary in such a case?

blocks.zh: 三組容易混淆的術語
blocks.en: Three Easily Confused Pairs of Terms

blocks.zh:
1. Knowledge Transfer vs. Technology Transfer
KT（知識移轉）是 TT 的一個子集或核心活動——它專注於「知識」的傳遞（製程數據、秘訣、控制策略）。TT 則更廣，包含設備評估、驗證、法規申報等整個工程。
blocks.en:
1. Knowledge Transfer vs. Technology Transfer
KT (knowledge transfer) is a subset or core activity of TT. It focuses on passing on "knowledge" (process data, know-how, control strategy). TT is broader and covers the whole effort, including equipment assessment, validation and regulatory submissions.

blocks.zh:
2. Engineering Batch vs. PPQ Batch
Engineering Batch（工程批）用於確認移轉的可行性，是試跑性質；PPQ Batch（製程效能資格確認批）是正式驗證，數據用於法規申報。兩者不可混用。
blocks.en:
2. Engineering Batch vs. PPQ Batch
An engineering batch is used to confirm the feasibility of the transfer and is a trial run. A PPQ (process performance qualification) batch is formal validation, and its data are used for regulatory submissions. The two must not be used interchangeably.

blocks.zh:
3. Stage Gate vs. Milestone
Stage Gate 是正式的決策關卡，需要 Steering Committee 批准才能進入下一階段；Milestone 是時間節點，未必有決策功能。TR65 的六個 Stage Gate 是「有否決權的」。
blocks.en:
3. Stage Gate vs. Milestone
A stage gate is a formal decision point that requires Steering Committee approval before the next stage can begin. A milestone is a point in time and does not necessarily have a decision function. The six stage gates in TR65 carry "veto power".

blocks.zh: 比喻：Stage Gate = 移民入境審查
blocks.en: Analogy: Stage Gate = Immigration Control

blocks.zh: 每個 Stage Gate 就像出入境審查：你可以準備好所有行李（活動完成），但必須通過審查官（Steering Committee）批准，才能登上下一班飛機（進入下一階段）。審查官有權要你補件或暫停行程。
blocks.en: Each stage gate is like immigration control. You may have all your luggage ready (activities completed), but you must be cleared by the officer (the Steering Committee) before boarding the next flight (entering the next stage). The officer has the authority to ask for more documents or to halt your trip.

blocks.zh: Facility Fit Assessment — 最容易被忽略的起點
blocks.en: Facility Fit Assessment: The Most Easily Overlooked Starting Point

blocks.zh: 許多 TT 失敗案例都源於 Facility Fit Assessment 做得不夠深入。這個評估在 Initiation 階段就要啟動，涵蓋：設備能力、廠房設計、容量規劃，以及與該產品相關的特定風險（例如高活性、冷鏈、特殊 CCI 需求）。
blocks.en: Many failed TTs trace back to a Facility Fit Assessment that was not thorough enough. This assessment must start in the Initiation stage and covers equipment capability, facility design, capacity planning, and product-specific risks (for example high potency, cold chain, special CCI needs).

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：QTPP 是契約的基礎
blocks.en: CDMO Application: The QTPP Is the Basis of the Contract

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，QTPP（品質目標產品特性）是最重要的入場文件。它定義了客戶對藥品品質的期望（效能、安全性、穩定性等），是 TT 合約範疇確認與成功標準設定的起點。若客戶在 TT 開始時無法提供完整的 QTPP，是風險訊號。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the QTPP (Quality Target Product Profile) is the most important entry document. It defines the client's expectations for drug quality (performance, safety, stability, etc.) and is the starting point for confirming the TT contract scope and setting success criteria. If the client cannot provide a complete QTPP at the start of TT, that is a risk signal.

blocks.zh: 最關鍵的縮寫對：SU 與 RU
blocks.en: The Most Critical Pair of Abbreviations: SU and RU

blocks.zh: SU（Sending Unit，送出廠）：持有現有產品知識的廠址。
blocks.en: SU (Sending Unit): the site that holds the existing product knowledge.

blocks.zh: RU（Receiving Unit，接收廠）：未來將生產或檢測該產品的廠址。
blocks.en: RU (Receiving Unit): the site that will manufacture or test the product in the future.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 情境中，客戶（MAH）通常是 SU，CDMO 是 RU。但若客戶將產品從一家 CDMO 移轉到另一家，MAH 可能需要充當「中介 SU」，因為兩家 CDMO 可能互不認識。
blocks.en: In a CDMO scenario, the client (MAH) is usually the SU and the CDMO is the RU. However, if the client moves a product from one CDMO to another, the MAH may need to act as an "intermediary SU", because the two CDMOs may not know each other.

blocks.zh: MAH — 最終責任人
blocks.en: MAH: The Ultimately Responsible Party

blocks.zh: MAH（上市許可持有人）是對監管機關負責的一方，無論 TT 涉及幾個外部廠商，MAH 永遠是「合約授予方（contract giver）」，也是最終法規責任的承擔者。在外部-外部移轉中，MAH 必須主動介入，不能坐等兩家廠商自行協調。
blocks.en: The MAH (Marketing Authorization Holder) is the party accountable to the regulatory authority. No matter how many external vendors are involved in a TT, the MAH is always the "contract giver" and bears the final regulatory responsibility. In an external-to-external transfer, the MAH must step in actively and cannot wait for the two vendors to coordinate on their own.

blocks.zh: 比喻：PAI 是最後的「大考」
blocks.en: Analogy: PAI Is the Final "Big Exam"

blocks.zh: PAI（預批准查廠）就像大學入學考試——TT 的所有工作都在為這個時刻備考。Steering Committee 的 Stage Gate 是平時月考，PAI 是最終學測。所有驗證批次、文件、分析方法轉移都是考試科目。
blocks.en: The PAI (Pre-Approval Inspection) is like a university entrance exam: all the work in TT is preparation for this moment. The Steering Committee stage gates are the regular monthly tests, and the PAI is the final exam. All the validation batches, documents and analytical method transfers are the exam subjects.

blocks.zh: 在您的組織中，SU 和 RU 的角色分工是否有書面協議？FAT/SAT 是否被納入 TT 計畫？這些縮寫背後的活動，在您的 TT 流程中是否都有對應的負責人？
blocks.en: In your organization, are the roles of SU and RU set out in a written agreement? Are FAT/SAT included in the TT plan? Is there a responsible owner in your TT process for the activities behind each of these abbreviations?

blocks.zh: TT 分類的兩個維度
blocks.en: Two Dimensions of TT Classification

blocks.zh: TR65 用兩個獨立維度來分類 TT：
blocks.en: TR65 classifies TT using two independent dimensions:

blocks.zh: 維度一：產品生命週期（3.1）— 從哪個開發階段移轉到哪個階段
blocks.en: Dimension 1: product lifecycle (3.1): from which development stage to which stage the product is transferred

blocks.zh: 維度二：廠址類型（3.2）— 內部廠到內部廠？還是涉及外部 CMO/CDMO？
blocks.en: Dimension 2: site type (3.2): internal site to internal site, or does it involve an external CMO/CDMO?

blocks.zh: 這兩個維度組合，決定了 TT 的複雜度與 CMC 要求的深度。
blocks.en: The combination of these two dimensions determines the complexity of the TT and the depth of the CMC requirements.

blocks.zh: 不只是製程移轉
blocks.en: More Than Process Transfer

blocks.zh: 注意：分析方法移轉（Analytical Method Transfer）也是 TT 的一部分！許多人只想到製程，但分析方法（如 HPLC 效價、無菌測試、粒徑分析）的移轉同樣需要驗證、比對，也需要跟著 TR65 的框架走。
blocks.en: Note: analytical method transfer is also part of TT! Many people think only of the process, but the transfer of analytical methods (such as HPLC potency, sterility testing and particle size analysis) likewise requires validation and comparison, and should also follow the TR65 framework.

blocks.zh: Development-Commercial 的關鍵時間壓力
blocks.en: Development-Commercial: The Key Time Pressure

blocks.zh: Phase III 到商業化的 TT 是「發展開發與 TT 並行」的賽跑。常見陷阱：
blocks.en: TT from Phase III to commercialization is a race in which development and TT run in parallel. Common pitfalls:

blocks.zh: Phase III 結束才啟動 TT → 時間壓力極大
blocks.en: Starting TT only after Phase III ends: enormous time pressure

blocks.zh: CMC 要求在 TT 過程中仍在演變 → 計畫不斷更改
blocks.en: CMC requirements are still evolving during TT: the plan keeps changing

blocks.zh: 雜質特性在 Phase III 到驗證批之間改變 → 重新比對
blocks.en: The impurity profile changes between Phase III and the validation batches: comparability must be re-done

blocks.zh: 最佳實務：Phase III 開始時同步啟動 TT 規劃。
blocks.en: Best practice: start TT planning at the beginning of Phase III.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Commercial-Commercial 是「搬家」，不是「建新家」
blocks.en: Analogy: Commercial-Commercial Is "Moving House", Not "Building a New One"

blocks.zh: Commercial-Commercial TT 就像帶著已經裝潢好的家具搬到新公寓。你知道這些家具能用（有歷史數據），但新空間的格局不同，需要重新排列（設備適配），甚至趁機換一些舊家具（製程改良）。但改太多，法規機關可能要你重新申報。
blocks.en: Commercial-Commercial TT is like moving fully furnished furniture into a new apartment. You know the furniture works (there are historical data), but the layout of the new space is different and needs rearranging (equipment adaptation), and you may even replace some old pieces while you are at it (process improvement). But change too much, and the regulator may ask you to file again.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：最常見的是哪一種？
blocks.en: CDMO Application: Which Is the Most Common?

blocks.zh: 對 TWi 而言，最常見的情境是 Development-Commercial（新客戶的 Phase III 產品導入商業生產）和 Commercial-Commercial（客戶因產能或法規考量，將已上市產品從其他廠移轉過來）。前者挑戰最大，因為 CMC 要求尚在發展中；後者相對有歷史數據支撐，但需小心「製程改良機會」的法規影響。
blocks.en: For TWi, the most common scenarios are Development-Commercial (a new client's Phase III product being brought into commercial production) and Commercial-Commercial (a client moving an already marketed product from another site for capacity or regulatory reasons). The former is the most challenging because the CMC requirements are still developing. The latter is backed by historical data, but the regulatory impact of "process improvement opportunities" must be handled carefully.

blocks.zh: 您最近參與的 TT 屬於哪一種生命週期類型？在 Development-Commercial 的情境下，如何判斷 Phase III 的 CMC 套件是否「成熟」到可以啟動 TT 了？
blocks.en: Which lifecycle type does the TT you took part in most recently belong to? In a Development-Commercial scenario, how do you judge whether the Phase III CMC package is "mature" enough to start TT?

blocks.zh: 廠址類型的複雜度排序
blocks.en: Site Types Ranked by Complexity

blocks.zh: Internal-Internal — 最易管理：同一 QMS、共用文件系統
blocks.en: Internal-Internal: easiest to manage, with the same QMS and a shared document system

blocks.zh: 複雜度 ↓
blocks.en: Complexity ↓

blocks.zh: Internal-External / External-Internal — 中等：跨組織協調、不同 QMS 對接
blocks.en: Internal-External / External-Internal: moderate, requiring cross-organization coordination and interfacing of different QMSs

blocks.zh: External-External — 最難：兩家外部廠互不相識，MAH 需充當 SU
blocks.en: External-External: the hardest, because the two external sites do not know each other and the MAH must act as the SU

blocks.zh: External TT 的合約保護重點
blocks.en: Key Contract Protections for External TT

blocks.zh: TR65 特別強調：SU 的 SME 要到外部廠現場支援，必須在合約中明文規定。常見的合約漏洞：
blocks.en: TR65 specifically stresses that SU SME support at the external site must be stated explicitly in the contract. Common contract gaps:

blocks.zh: 沒有規定 SU 技術人員出差天數和費用分擔
blocks.en: No provision for the number of travel days of SU technical staff and how the costs are shared

blocks.zh: 沒有界定 SU 在 TT 後仍需支援的期限
blocks.en: No definition of how long the SU must continue to provide support after TT

blocks.zh: 沒有處理兩廠在 QMS 差異上的責任歸屬
blocks.en: No allocation of responsibility for differences between the two sites' QMSs

blocks.zh: 在談判 TT 合約時，這些點都要逐條確認。
blocks.en: When negotiating a TT contract, each of these points should be confirmed item by item.

blocks.zh: 比喻：External-External = 婚姻媒合介紹人
blocks.en: Analogy: External-External = A Matchmaker

blocks.zh: 在 External-External TT 中，MAH 就像婚姻介紹所。兩家外部廠商（SU 和 RU）不認識彼此，MAH 要負責「撮合」——介紹背景、促成見面、甚至在兩方鬧別扭時出面調解。如果介紹所（MAH）不積極介入，婚事（TT）很可能告吹。
blocks.en: In an External-External TT, the MAH is like a matchmaking agency. The two external vendors (SU and RU) do not know each other, and the MAH is responsible for "bringing them together": introducing their backgrounds, arranging the meeting, and even mediating when the two sides fall out. If the agency (MAH) does not get actively involved, the match (TT) is likely to fall through.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的現實：我們最常是哪種角色？
blocks.en: The CDMO Reality: Which Role Do We Play Most Often?

blocks.zh: 對 TWi 而言：
blocks.en: For TWi:

blocks.zh: 最常見：Internal-External（客戶是 MAH/SU，TWi 是 External RU）
blocks.en: Most common: Internal-External (the client is the MAH/SU and TWi is the external RU)

blocks.zh: 偶見：External-External（客戶的原廠 CDMO 是 SU，TWi 是新 RU，MAH 居中協調）
blocks.en: Occasional: External-External (the client's original CDMO is the SU, TWi is the new RU, and the MAH coordinates in the middle)

blocks.zh: 挑戰最大：External-External，尤其當原廠 CDMO 不願配合知識轉移時
blocks.en: Most challenging: External-External, especially when the original CDMO is unwilling to cooperate on knowledge transfer

blocks.zh: 理解自己在哪種廠址類型情境中，有助於在合約談判中預判風險。
blocks.en: Understanding which site type scenario you are in helps you anticipate risks during contract negotiation.

blocks.zh: 在 External-Internal 的情境（CDMO 開發、MAH 接回自廠生產）中，誰應該擔任 TT PM？CDMO 有動機讓移轉順利進行嗎？這種利益衝突如何在合約和治理結構中化解？
blocks.en: In an External-Internal scenario (a CDMO develops the product and the MAH takes it back to its own site for production), who should serve as the TT PM? Does the CDMO have an incentive to make the transfer go smoothly? How can this conflict of interest be resolved through the contract and the governance structure?

blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 核心學習要點
blocks.en: Key Learning Points

blocks.zh: Section 0 的三個核心洞察
blocks.en: Three Core Insights from Section 0

blocks.zh: TT 有邊界：從啟動到監管批准後的 Handover，是有開始和結束的專案，不是持續性職責。
blocks.en: TT has boundaries: from initiation to Handover after regulatory approval, it is a project with a beginning and an end, not an ongoing responsibility.

blocks.zh: TT 有兩個分類維度：生命週期（到哪個階段）+ 廠址類型（涉及哪種組織關係），組合起來決定複雜度。
blocks.en: TT has two classification dimensions: lifecycle (to which stage) + site type (which organizational relationship is involved). Combined, they determine the complexity.

blocks.zh: 知識是核心資產：KT 和 KM 是貫穿整個 TT 的靈魂——如果知識沒有被系統性地移轉和管理，所有的文件和驗證都只是空殼。
blocks.en: Knowledge is the core asset: KT and KM run through the whole TT. If knowledge is not transferred and managed systematically, all the documents and validation are just an empty shell.
